```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Extract Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Build extract CDK
        run: ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:buildCdk

      - name: Publish extract CDK
        run: ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:publishCdk
        env:
          NEXUS_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_USERNAME }}
          NEXUS_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Check extract version
        run: ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:checkExtractVersion
```
